# Observe.AI separates guidance from display


By OpenTools Team


·


November 4, 2026


Enterprises choose where events appear.


##


Routing


Observe.AI’s November 3 release describes Headless Companion Agent as a deployment option for its existing assistant. Structured events go to customer‑configured endpoints; the enterprise decides which outputs appear in its human‑agent desktop and what actions they trigger.[1](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/observeai-launches-headless-companion-agent-to-bring-real-time-guidance--automation-into-cx-agents-desktop-302925725.html?tc=eml_cleartime)


##


Choices


The visible Companion option remains. Endpoint integration and presentation therefore stay separate decisions. The release describes SoFi’s initial after‑call workflows, without measured evidence of savings or better outcomes.[1](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/observeai-launches-headless-companion-agent-to-bring-real-time-guidance--automation-into-cx-agents-desktop-302925725.html?tc=eml_cleartime)


Call‑center workplace, São Paulo, December 2012; archive, not Observe.AI or SoFi use. Photo:[Carlos Ebert / Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Call_center_%288300429013%29.jpg) ,[CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) . Cropped for display.
